description.value: The Local General Store is a neighbourhood grocery and gift shop at Haultain Corners in Victoria, specializing in locally sourced and organic produce, fresh bread from a rotating roster of artisan bakeries, and ethically sourced gifts. Open since 2013 and under new ownership since May 2023, it serves as a community hub connecting customers directly with local farmers, bakers, and artisans. A touring cyclist could resupply here with fresh fruit, vegetables, baked goods, and vegan or gluten-free options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the store's identity, phone number, and address at Haultain Corners (Belmont & Haultain), Victoria. Product offerings (fresh produce, bread, groceries, artisan goods) confirm the Groceries category. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any of the cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-Fr 09:30-18:00; Sa-Su 09:30-17:30) conflict with website, which lists Monday–Saturday 9 AM–5:30 PM and explicitly states Sunday closed. OSM hours appear outdated; website value preferred.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active neighbourhood grocery with fresh local produce, artisan bread, and organic options in Victoria — a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the Haultain Corners area.

wow_evidence: specializing in locally sourced and organic produce, fresh bread from a rotating roster of artisan bakeries
